title: Chapter 787
paragraphs: Chapter 787
Episode 194. Unexpected Encounter (1)
The messenger from Kellic who showed the Seal of Fire to Jett revealed his name to be 'Pi', who was a dragon.
Barely over a hundred years old, from the perspective of dragons, he was as young as a baby. Pi, transformed into a human, looked even younger than Ratree.
He also appeared to be extremely disheveled. His hood that covered his entire body was in tatters, and his face was smeared with grime.
Out of breath.
The party looked at Pi who was hastily stuffing food into his mouth.
Despite looking like a beggar who hadn't eaten for days, Pi's appearance wasn't just indicating hard times.

Jin and his companions could smell the scent of smoke and blood from him. A deep smell of the battlefield, which couldn't be covered by the freshly made hot soup and the unique sweet smell of Ratree's cookies.
It was strange.
Dragons of Pi's age don't possess much combat power. It's an age that can hardly survive without the protection of other dragons, similar to a newborn in human terms.
Hence, both Quicantel and Ratree were not pleased just by seeing Pi. Even though he was an enemy, from their perspective, it was a young dragon who should be protected, performing a dangerous task.
"Phew, well, that was a good meal! I feel like I can survive now...!"
Pi said, emptying the last plate.
"If you need more, let me know. We'll serve more food."
Jin was treating Pi in a non-threatening way, conscious of Quicantel and Ratree.
"No, this is enough. I didn't expect such hospitality, thank you so much."
Pi was acting so humble that it seemed as if the members of Tikan purposely sent a kind and young dragon to make them feel weak.
"Now, let's talk about why you've come to us."
Yuria stepped forward.
"From now on, I will use the power of my eye to verify the truth of everything you say. I hope you don't mind."
"Of course, I don't mind. Firstly, I've come to negotiate with you following the will of Lord Shinu and Sir Kellic."
An unexpected name came up from the start.
"…Shinu?"
"Yes, Lord Jin. Lord Shinu wishes for you to assist Sir Kellic."
"Assistance, huh? Before I hear what kind of assistance is needed, I must first understand the situation. What was the reason Kellic was attacked by Beradin at the Tower of Stories?"
"It's treason. Lord Kellic is now unfairly accused of coveting the power of the evil spirit and is being purged. Beradin Ziffle committed treason to consume his family."
A blue thread rose between the gazes of Pi and Yuria. It was the truth.
"Why did Beradin commit treason?"
"Lord Shinu and Sir Kellic believe it is due to the side effects of mind control experiments."
"I'd like to hear more detail. What was the reason Kellic has been mind-controlling Beradin, and what result was he trying to achieve?"
Unsurprisingly, Pi was not flustered by the question.
"Lord Kellic wished to become the new god of fire through Beradin Ziffle."
"…Excuse me?"

"For some reason, Lord Shinu is slowly fading away. Therefore, he gave the task of becoming the second god of fire to Lord Kellic, and all the experiments conducted on Beradin Ziffle were for this purpose."
The blue thread continued to form, signifying truth.
A moment of silence followed the unexpected shocking news.

"You must be surprised. But it's all true. The reason others could use the power of Lord Shinu, excluding Lord Kellic, is that the fragmented power of Lord Shinu due to his fading away was given to them. People like Beradin Ziffle and Midor Elnur."
"How can Kellic become the god of fire through Beradin?"
"I'm sorry, I don't know the specifics. However, I do know it's possible if Beradin is used as a vessel for the Mashin Stone…"
Vessel of the Mashin Stone.
As soon as he heard those words, Jin remembered that Beradin had made a pact with 'two gods'. The God of Water, Itelmyon, and the God of Earth, Likta.
It's established in the world of magic that one human cannot have pacts with two gods.
Jin had wondered how Beradin had a pact with two gods at the end of his pre-knight period, but he didn't pursue it.
-You're not asking?
-What?
-How I made a pact with two gods.
-Your potential must be that exceptional. And do I look like I want to ask that now, in this situation?
The situation was urgent back then, and Jin thought Beradin wouldn't know the reason either. If Beradin knew why he could make a pact with two gods, he would have said it on his own.
'The Mashin Stone holds the power of all gods... and Kellic has been experimenting to make Beradin a core ingredient of the Mashin Stone!'
"If Beradin possessed the properties of the Mashin Stone, it could easily explain why he was able to form a simultaneous contract with Itelmyon and Likta."

"…Shinu, Kellic, and Ziffle. No matter how I think about it, they are all mad. Even a young dragon like you talks about such a horrifying story as if it's nothing. Pi, you're talking about humans using humans, a father using his child as a test subject. Don't you feel anything about that?"
Quicantel said in fury. She was upset seeing a young dragon telling such a horrifying story with an emotionless face.
"I'm not sure what I'm supposed to feel…. Is that a problem?"
"This is insane."

"Anyway, Pi, if we combine your words, this is it. Shinu and Kellic tried to create the Mashin Stone and a new god of fire through Beradin, and at some point, Beradin stopped following obediently and instead purged Kellic."
"That's correct."
"According to you, Shinu and Kellic suspect Beradin's betrayal as a side effect of the experiment, or a personal vendetta. But Sanna's story is missing."
"Oh, you mean the Sun Priestess."
"In the Tower of Stories, who saved Kellic, who was at risk of dying, was it Shinu?"
According to the records manipulated by Sanna, it was Rokia Ganesto who saved Kellic.
Pi nodded.
"Yes, Lord Shinu saved him."
Jin did not inform Pi about Sanna's manipulation of the records. It was not entirely impossible that Sanna could be in a cooperative relationship with Shinu and Kellic.

"When did she start working with Ziffle? It seemed like she was cooperating with Beradin now, were Shinu and Kellic stabbed in the back? As you said at first, Sanna said that Kellic coveted the power of the evil spirit."

"That's exactly as you saw. I heard that the Sun Priestess began to cooperate with the family after the war against the evil spirit ended. The Priestess approached the family, saying she could cure Lord Kellic."
"So Shinu and Kellic simply believed her and accepted what she said?"

"I don't know the exact details. However, given the situation, I think they had no choice. Anyway, the Priestess just stood by when Beradin attacked Lord Kellic. Perhaps Beradin's betrayal was the result that the Priestess prompted."
Since Pi wasn't directly conversing with Shinu or Kellic, the information she could provide was limited.
Even if they verified Pi's story with the power of truth, they couldn't entirely believe everything. Because what Yuria was confirming was whether Pi was lying or not.
'Pi is certainly telling everything she knows. But among the information that Shinu and Kellic have told Pi, there could be false information.'
The content that Beradin framed Kellic and the fact that Shinu is fading away are likely to be true.

"If that wasn't the case, there would have been no reason for Pi to come to Tikan for negotiations right now. To make the Bamel Alliance complacent, causing Kelliac to go on a rampage and suppressing him is too much.
Also, Jin felt that Shinu and Kelliac were in a predicament right now.
"Tell me now what Shinu and Kelliac want from me."
"Yes, Lord Jin. They want you to heal Lord Kelliac."
"What's the price?"
"They said they would reveal various secrets of Zipl, which you would be curious about. They also promised to remove the covenant between Zipl and Runcandle made a thousand years ago."
Chuckling, Jin sneered at the offer.
"They're just throwing things out there. I doubt they really thought I would accept that offer. Right? Besides, his chaos is beyond the level I can handle with my purifier."
"Lord Shinu said that it would be possible someday when the purifier is improved."

"Even so, I have no reason to heal Kelliac. The situation must be pretty bad for you to come to Tikan and propose such negotiations. For me, it's rather a windfall. If left alone, Kelliac will be doomed."
"But breaking the covenant and learning the secrets of Zipl would definitely be a big help to you......"
"I'm already working on breaking the covenant myself, and I'm not interested in Zipl's secrets. I might be interested in information about Sanna, the Sun Religion, or Rokia Ganesto."
Pi seemed at a loss for words.
"To be more precise, I have no intention of helping Kelliac, no matter what I have to give up. Shinu and Kelliac would have expected my answer. Where is he now?"
"He's in the Land of Fire, Lord Shinu's territory."

"Then, bring one of Shinu and Kelliac to me directly or arrange for us to visit there. We will resume the conversation then. If you send someone else in your place to test me again, tell them I won't listen at all next time. You may go now."
"Wait, wait! Lord Jin. Uh-ah."
In Pi's eyes, which were calling Jin desperately, flames suddenly sparked.
And the companions felt a tremendous energy spread in the place. It was not just the energy of a 'strong person', but that of a transcendental being.
The companions retreated, taken aback, and Jin looked up at Pi floating in the air, smiling thinly.
"As expected. You were listening, Shinu. If you want something from me, you should have made a personal appearance like this earlier."
The Fire God Shinu had incarnated through Pi.
